Usage: rig scope slice [options] [command]

Slice-tier commands

Options:
  -h, --help                                     display help for command

Commands:
  ls [options]                                   List slices in a mission (or across all missions)
  show [options] <slice-path>                    Inspect a single slice (frontmatter + README + children)
  create [options] <mission> <slug>              Create a new slice with SPEC.md, slice.yaml, PROGRESS.md, PROOF.md, and proof/. Conventions SSOT: docs/reference/sdlc-conventions.md (installed: $OPENRIG_HOME/reference/sdlc-conventions.md).
  ship [options] <slice-path> <release-mission>  Ship a slice to a release mission (preserves git history)
  close [options] <slice-path>                   Close a slice (move to <mission>/closed/, update status)
  move [options] <slice-path> <dest-mission>     Move a slice between missions (re-numbers in destination)
  progress [options] <slice-path>                Update a slice's progress rail deterministically (append a row, or set a row's status)
  repair [options] <slice-path>                  Backfill a slice's missing PROGRESS.md + conform mandatory frontmatter (id/stage/verified); idempotent
  stage [options] <slice-path> <new-stage>       Set a slice's epistemic stage (wip | provisional | established | canonical | superseded | retired); superseded needs --successor
  verified [options] <slice-path>                Stamp a slice's verified line: <today> against <source> (provenance mandatory; overwrites the prior line)
  approve [options] <slice-path>                 Approve a slice: writes the frontmatter stamp + an append-only audit row (daemon-side, one operation). --scope spec = the PLAN-LOCK (PRD-matches-intent; this artifact set gets built); delivery (default) = the PROOF-LOCK (terminal sign-off). Approval is freeze/sign-off, never proven-green. Conventions SSOT: docs/reference/sdlc-conventions.md (installed: $OPENRIG_HOME/reference/sdlc-conventions.md).
  help [command]                                 display help for command

Workspace: the parent option --workspace selects the missions root this command reads.
  rig scope --workspace <project root> slice <verb> ...
A project root uses its project.yaml missions.root, else its missions/ folder; a
folder named missions is used as is. Use it for a catalog project, for example
$(rig config get workspace.projects_root)/<project>. Without --workspace,
OPENRIG_WORK_ROOT applies, then the configured workspace.slices_root.
